rationale: Fresh whole-world quality accept against this exact prospective proposal and retained audit. I re-inspected all 252 concept labels/descriptions, 352 pair explanations, 32 goals, 12 unlock groups and ten compatible-version mechanics. Exact object comparison with installed n1 preserves 248 concepts and every recipe, goal, unlock, starter and historical version; the only four changes append ordinary forms to concept snapshot aliases. Their new source judgments preserve the pastry sense of brânzoaică, the wheel/variety plural of cașcaval, the chiftea noun versus chifti verb, and the unresolved DOOM3 versus DOR gender distinction for șnițel. This is morphology coverage, not new recipes or concepts, and the exploration service combines owned IDs rather than these alias strings. The eight everyday starters provide nine productive pairs with seven first discoveries, giving several understandable openings before thresholds release pantry, meal and confectionery ingredients. Reusable intermediates such as dough, sauces, choux pastry, breadcrumbs and fistic-kataif filling connect familiar foods to later goals; the two-idea abstraction is stated to players and explanations supply the omitted preparation rather than presenting each pair as a full cooking recipe. Some inherited everyday definitions are terse category descriptions and repeated fruit/conserve or sandwich routes offer variation rather than wholly novel reasoning; those are quality limits, not new regressions. Static closure reaches all 252 concepts through 148 distinct outputs; every pair has one result, valid endpoints and no result equal to an input, and every optional goal is reachable without being a starter. Actual audit rows contain 33 complete replays, each with 148 discoveries, and ten historical books whose 1156 retained prefixes preserve earned concepts. Inspection of audit code establishes goal-independent terminal progress, repeated-pair non-discovery and complete-save restoration along its deterministic traversal; it does not establish every possible player order or enjoyment. Current KG, pack, rankings, derived and installed quick bytes match the audit bindings. Service serialization shows recipes through earned discoveries and controlled hints, and undiscovered target IDs are hidden while goal labels remain intentionally visible. I did not rerun native audits or inspect all 151 runtime source bytes; their native provenance remains for normal confirmation. Acceptance covers the exact prospective content and inspected retained evidence, with the unchanged independence guard and installation checks still required; no installed-world or production qualification is claimed.
